    About me

    I’m Brandon, originally from Scotland and now based in London, working in technology investment banking.

    I’m passionate about AI, startups and scaleups across the European tech ecosystem. I’m particularly interested in ambitious founders, emerging technologies and the businesses shaping the future.

    What I’m doing

    This page is a collection of my investment ideas, exploring companies I’m following, what makes them interesting to me, and the questions I’d want to answer before investing. It’s a space to develop my thinking, challenge my assumptions and share ideas as they evolve.
